newsitem.title: FRANCE: French foreign minister to visit Angola Friday.
newsitem.headline: French foreign minister to visit Angola Friday.

text.p: French Foreign Minister Herve de Charette will visit Angola on Friday for talks with government leaders on implementing 1994 peace accords ending a 20-year civil war, a ministry spokesman said on Wednesday.
De Charette planned talks with President Jose Eduardo Dos Santos, Prime Minister Fernando Franca Van Dunem and Foreign Minister Venancio da Silva de Moura.

"The minister is going to Luanda notably to review the peace process," Foreign Ministry spokesman Jacques Rummelhardt told reporters. The United Nations is planning to start a pullout of a 6,500-strong force from the end of December.
